content.short: 5,555 Hand-drawn and randomized gumballs rolling around in the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description: Our NFTs are all hand-drawn and quality checked individually as we want to ensure that the minters receive only the highest quality of NFTs. This is because we have seen one too many NFTs created with stock images overlapped by a cartoon skin yet many buyers are willing to pay decent money to mint it. We wish to establish and set a benchmark for other subsequent projects in the future that offer low-quality NFTs at an insanely high mint price.
